indicators.name: Tautology
indicators.description: Always-true comparison in an SQL-like expression.
indicators.recommendation: Use parameterized queries and reject user-controlled SQL fragments.

indicators.name: Comment truncation
indicators.description: Quote or parenthesis followed by a SQL comment marker.
indicators.recommendation: Use parameterized queries and reject comment-based query suffixes.

indicators.name: UNION-based injection
indicators.description: UNION or UNION ALL followed by SELECT.
indicators.recommendation: Use parameterized queries and do not concatenate user input into SELECT statements.

indicators.name: Stacked query
indicators.description: A semicolon followed by a second SQL statement.
indicators.recommendation: Reject multiple statements and use a driver that disables multi-statement execution.

indicators.name: Destructive statement
indicators.description: Destructive DDL/DML, including DELETE without WHERE.
indicators.recommendation: Restrict destructive SQL and require explicit, separately authorized operations.

indicators.name: Time-based blind SQLi
indicators.description: Database delay functions used to infer query results.
indicators.recommendation: Reject delay functions in user-controlled queries and use parameterized statements.

indicators.name: Error-based SQLi
indicators.description: Database XML/error functions or casts around subqueries.
indicators.recommendation: Use parameterized queries and avoid returning database errors to callers.

indicators.name: Schema probing
indicators.description: References to database catalog or account tables.
indicators.recommendation: Deny access to system catalogs unless explicitly required by the tool.

indicators.name: Boolean-blind probing
indicators.description: Boolean comparison or string extraction used as a conditional probe.
indicators.recommendation: Use parameterized queries and avoid exposing query-result differences to untrusted callers.

indicators.name: Dangerous database function
indicators.description: File access, command execution, or COPY PROGRAM functionality.
indicators.recommendation: Disable database file and command-execution functions for application accounts.

indicators.name: Encoding evasion
indicators.description: Heavy percent encoding, SQL-context hex values, or CHAR/CHR chains.
indicators.recommendation: Canonicalize input once and bind values instead of decoding SQL fragments.

indicators.name: Quote anomaly
indicators.description: Unbalanced quotes alongside multiple SQL keywords.
indicators.recommendation: Validate expected input types and use bound parameters.

indicators.name: SQL keyword density
indicators.description: Several distinct SQL keywords in a field not configured for SQL.
indicators.recommendation: Treat identifiers and free-text fields as values, not query fragments.

indicators.name: Read-only mode violation
indicators.description: Non-SELECT SQL submitted to a read-only tool.
indicators.recommendation: Use a read-only database role and permit only a single SELECT statement.

indicators.name: Oversized input
indicators.description: Input exceeded the SQL analysis size limit and was truncated.
indicators.recommendation: Keep tool arguments within documented size limits.
